title: 'I may not return alive': Ex-Pakistan PM Imran Khan seeks urgent medical help
summary_full: Imran Khan has appealed to Pakistan's top courts for urgent medical care for himself and his wife. He claims that his health has deteriorated significantly during solitary confinement, where he is held for up to 22 hours daily. Khan alleges that authorities neglected previous court orders regarding his medical treatment and communication with family. He expressed concern for his wife's rapidly declining vision and health after a recent surgery.
